description.value: Terravista Vineyards is a small estate winery on the Naramata Bench — one of BC's most popular cycling corridors — specializing in rare Spanish white varieties such as Albariño and Verdejo alongside a premium small-lot series called En Terre. All three of the winery's Naramata Bench vineyards achieved 100% certified organic status in Fall 2025, reflecting a commitment to sustainable viticulture including solar arrays, electric utility vehicles, and livestock integration. Touring cyclists passing through the Okanagan can book seated tasting experiences and purchase wines directly on site.
